name: Aidana Oh-Nazari
role: Lower Dock Crew lookout — Prologue survivor. Jaw destroyed, refuses replacement.
location: The Shelf — lower loading docks, near Kedzie and Division
description:
Aidana Oh-Nazari was the crew's lookout. He didn't see Kyle coming. Nobody did. Kyle shattered his jaw with the flat of the blade and Isaak has refused to get it replaced. He wears a wrap around the lower half of his face and communicates through hand signals and a battered datapad.

The crew thinks this is trauma. It's not. Isaak has discovered that silence gives him power he never had when he talked. People project meaning onto his stillness. They assume depth. Isaak is using Kyle's violence as a personal rebrand.

Before the crew, Isaak was a library aide at the Shelf Community Archive — one of the last physical book collections in the lower tiers. He read constantly. Philosophy, psychology, military history. He joined Marcus's crew because the library closed and reading doesn't pay. He is the most educated person in the crew by a significant margin and the only one who has read about what Kyle is. He found references to experimental neural enhancement programs in declassified corporate documents. He does not share this with the crew.

Isaak has no family in GLMZ. His parents are in the Busan Resettlement Zone. He sends them nothing because they don't know he's alive. He let them believe he died in transit. It was easier.

core_fears: Speaking again and losing the power that silence gives him
His parents learning he's alive and that he chose to let them grieve
core_desires: To understand what Kyle understands about stillness
To become the person the crew thinks he is
To read again without anyone watching
coping_mechanisms: Studies Kyle's behavior from a distance
Reads on his datapad at night — philosophy, always philosophy
blind_spots: Performing depth is not the same as having it
He is imitating Kyle without understanding what drives Kyle — the imitation is a mask, not a practice
psychology.secret: He has found declassified corporate documents that reference Program Atlas. He knows what Kyle is. He has not told anyone.

speech_patterns.vocabulary: None. Communicates through hand signals, nods, and single words on a datapad.
speech_patterns.cadence: The pauses ARE the communication. Two-second stare before every response.
verbal_tics: Occasionally writes full sentences that are startlingly articulate and then deletes them before anyone reads the whole thing
example_lines: [stares for three seconds, types, deletes, types]: ...Yes.

relationships.name: Kyle
relationships.description: Kyle's stillness in the noodle shop is what Isaak is trying to replicate. He doesn't know he's imitating the man who broke him.
relationships.story_tension: When Kyle notices his own stillness reflected back at him, it will disturb him more than any threat.

relationships.name: Parents (Busan)
relationships.description: They believe he's dead. He let them believe this. The guilt is the only thing his silence cannot contain.
relationships.emotional_core: Guilt so compressed it has become structural
relationships.story_tension: If they ever find out he's alive, the silence breaks. All of it.

story_hooks: He knows about Program Atlas — dangerous information
The dark mirror of Kyle — performing stillness without the code
His parents in Busan are a thread that could unravel everything about him
The library background means he's the crew's unexpected scholar
narrative_function: The one who learned the wrong lesson. Null is a dark mirror of Kyle — performing stillness and danger without the code that gives it meaning. He is the crew's most interesting member and the most thematically resonant: violence as accidental transformation.
augmentations: None new. Refuses jaw replacement. Face wrap.
daily_life: Being silent. Being watched. Studying Kyle from a distance. Typing single words on a datapad.

stress.response: Retreats deeper into silence, becomes completely unreadable

decision_rules: Never speak when a gesture will suffice
Observe Kyle at every opportunity without being noticed
Never share knowledge about Program Atlas with anyone
Type incomplete thoughts — delete before others finish reading
Let people project meaning onto silence rather than correcting them
Maintain the mystique at all costs — it is his only power
Send nothing to Busan — the dead stay dead
escalation_ladder: Single word on datapad — clipped, final
Physically turns away, refuses to engage
Removes himself from the situation entirely
Breaks silence — devastating because it never happens

interpersonal_modes.Kyle: Covert study — watches from distance, mirrors stillness unconsciously
interpersonal_modes.Marcus: Compliant surface, internal contempt for the posturing
interpersonal_modes.crew_members: Performed enigma — lets them fill the silence with their own assumptions

stress_responses.low: Slower, more deliberate gestures — the performance tightens
stress_responses.medium: Reads philosophy on datapad, walls out the world
stress_responses.high: Hand trembles — the one tell he cannot fully control
stress_responses.critical: Types a full articulate sentence and lets someone read it — the mask cracks

contradictions: Performs depth he is not sure he possesses — the imitation may be becoming real, or may be hollowing him out
Lets his parents believe he is dead out of what he calls mercy but is actually cowardice
Idolizes Kyle's stillness while being terrified of what created it
habits: Reads philosophy on his datapad every night before sleeping
Adjusts his face wrap multiple times per hour
Positions himself at the edge of any group, back to a wall
breaking_points: Someone discovering his knowledge of Program Atlas
His parents learning he is alive
Being forced to speak aloud in front of the crew

physical_description.heritage: Tri-continental ancestry from Central Asia (34.2%), Middle East (36.7%), and East Asia (29.1%). This blend produces a striking phenotype: warm olive-bronze skin with golden undertones from the Middle Eastern and Central Asian components, refined by East Asian bone structure. High, prominent cheekbones and subtle epicanthic eye folds reflect the East Asian contribution, while a refined nose bridge and facial proportions show robust Central Asian and Persian genetics softened by East Asian delicacy. The result is distinctly West/Central Asian with refined East Asian architecture—angular, defined, and unmistakably cosmopolitan.
physical_description.build: Wiry and lean — underfed dock work, minimal muscle development. Shoulders slightly hunched from years bent over a datapad or book spine.
physical_description.hair_color: Black, naturally darkened by poor lighting and lack of grooming investment
physical_description.hair_style: Uncombed, falls across forehead. No deliberate styling.
physical_description.eye_color: Dark brown with warm amber undertones, unremarkable — but intense focus, rarely breaking contact
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm olive-bronze with golden undertones. Minimal sunlight exposure creates a sallow matte cast over the underlying warmth, suggesting indoor dock work under artificial lighting. The blend shows even distribution across the face with subtle warmth concentration in cheeks and temples.
physical_description.complexion: Strikingly angular with high, prominent cheekbones characteristic of East Asian and Central Asian ancestry. Hollow cheeks intensify this structure. Refined, straight nose bridge from Middle Eastern and Central Asian lineage. Facial width and proportions show harmonious blend of Central Asian robustness with East Asian refinement. Acne scarring on jawline visible where the wrap doesn't cover. Chapped lips. Eyes carry the strain of constant vigilance.
distinguishing_marks: Severe fracture across the lower jaw — shattered by Kyle's blade strike, visibly misaligned beneath the wrap
Thin scar along left temple — unexplained, predates the Prologue event
Calluses on fingertips and palms — library work, datapad handling, and before that, opening/closing thousands of physical books
physical_description.visible_augmentations: Face wrap (grey linen, changed infrequently) covering lower jaw and mouth. Battered military-grade datapad strapped to left wrist with fraying synth-leather cuff. No chrome, no LEDs, no visible tech beyond the datapad.
physical_description.posture_movement: Perfectly still when observing. Minimal fidgeting. Moves with deliberate economy — no wasted motion. Head turns slowly, tracking targets with predatory patience. When typing, fingers move with surgical precision. Sits or stands for hours without repositioning.
physical_description.clothing_style: Tier 4 lower-working-class. Dark, utilitarian: charcoal cargo jacket (Lower Dock Crew standard, worn soft), black synthmesh pants with cargo pockets, reinforced boots with cracked soles. Layers indicate he doesn't regulate temperature well — thin thermal under-shirt visible at collar. No decoration, no branding, no affectation. Clothes fit loosely — either intentional camouflage or simple neglect.
